items.title: Americans' social activity has steeply declined in the past 30 years
items.summary: 📝 Tracking data from the American Time Use Survey shows that Americans are spending more time alone and less time with friends than they were two decades ago. This survey finds significant, double-digit declines in Americans’ participation in key social activities from 1995 to 2026. This analysis adds to existing public data on America’s social decline.🔗 Read more: https://www.dataforprogress.org/blog/2026/9/29/americans-social-activity-has-steeply-declined-in-the-past-30-years

items.title: Anthropic's Scion is heavily inspired by Mononoke
items.summary: 📝 Here is Anthropic describing (archive link) yesterday how their new version control system, Scion, uses a concept called “derived data” to make operations like blames more efficient:How Anthropic describes Scion’s derived data. The fact that Sapling was only credited for “hard-won lessons”, and that Mononoke was not mentioned at all, borders on plagiarism. The post comes off as Anthropic claiming that Claude designed all this, while the reality is that our (extraordinary) team at Meta came up with many of the insights that Claude dutifully applied almost a decade later.🔗 Read more: https://sunshowers.io/posts/anthropic-mononoke/
